card.name: Scattered words before a continuing phrase
card.fires_on: No single word or setting fits. It marks mixed small words and symbols, such as a colon in a citation title, 'the' after 'around' or 'inside', and 'up' in 'up to'.

modes.label: Citation punctuation and digits
modes.description: Colon or digit inside reference entries, just before the rest of a title or page range.
modes.example: From the digital ,divide to digital inequality<<:>> studying Internet users as penetration increases

modes.label: The after a place preposition
modes.description: The word 'the' after 'around' or 'inside' in descriptions of physical objects.
modes.example: A rope, cable or belt usually runs inside<< the>> groove.

modes.label: Up in up to
modes.description: The word 'up' before 'to' in duration phrases.
modes.example: is 45 mcg/kg intravenously once every 3 to 6 weeks for<< up>> to 26 weeks

card.plain: It responds to a mix of unrelated small words and symbols, so there is no clear pattern to describe.
